result.description: A fictional portable studio interface designed for field recordists and podcast editors who need a compact, battery-powered workflow hub rather than a graphics or storage device. The Orion Tide 512K combines low-noise microphone preamps, a built-in sample-rate converter, and direct monitoring controls for quick capture sessions on laptops, tablets, or handheld recorders. It features dual combo inputs, balanced line outputs, USB-C connectivity, and onboard DSP for real-time gate and compressor presets. The unit is housed in a brushed aluminum enclosure with independent gain knobs, a color status display, and a mode switch for interview, music, and ambient capture profiles.
result.title: Orion Tide 512K Hybrid Audio Core
result.title_description: Portable USB-C audio interface for podcasting and field recording
